lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2064. A glass atrium with a ticker running the full length of it, planted with things that need more light than this climate gives them. Behind it, four buildings.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Thirty-three years and it has grown a lobby. The lab is still back there — same four buildings, two hundred metres. It is simply nobody's job to go into them any more.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: This is the counterparty. The actual one, with a floor and a receptionist and a coffee machine. When article nine says custody is assigned, this is the address it is assigned to.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I have spent four years writing amendments about an entity I had never seen. I had started to think of it as a legal fiction. It has a car park.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ticker is running allocation figures for regions that have not been called regions since before you were born. Nobody in the atrium is looking at it.
